scope: G4: process, reception materials and division of responsibility; no fabricated reviews or live account changes

roles.reception: Give the same neutral invitation to actual departing guests; assist only with opening the existing profile, never writing or posting for the guest.
roles.Beata: Coordinate reception rollout, verify correct existing Google profile and privacy-safe handling of feedback.
roles.Kamil: Approve business decisions and resolve escalations.
roles.websiteMaintainer: Keep profile links accurate; never manufacture or selectively publish favourable reviews.

steps: Offer one optional invitation at departure, regardless of whether feedback was positive or negative.
Do not offer a discount, gift, priority service or other benefit for posting, editing or removing a review.
Use the existing property profile and history; do not create a replacement listing.
The guest chooses whether, when and what to publish on their own device and account.
Handle service problems independently of any review; do not condition support or refunds on changing feedback.
Before replying publicly, check the facts internally; do not reveal stay dates, room numbers, contacts, billing details or other guest data.
Record aggregate counts and improvement actions privately; no guest identities or reviews copied into GitHub.

receptionCard.heading: Dobrowolna opinia po pobycie
receptionCard.text: Dziękujemy za pobyt w Hornigold w Zielonej Kamienicy. Jeśli chcesz, podziel się swoim doświadczeniem w naszym istniejącym profilu Google. Opinia jest dobrowolna — cenimy zarówno pochwały, jak i uwagi.
receptionCard.linkMeaning: Page links to current Google reviews; this is not a verified direct review-composer URL.

acceptanceChecklist: Beata confirms receipt and suitability for actual reception procedures.
Reception verifies that the linked profile is the existing Kopernika 6 property and retains its reviews.
Staff can explain the optional nature of the invitation and do not request a specific rating.
Any optional electronic outreach is checked against applicable communications and privacy rules before sending; this process does not authorise bulk email.
evidenceLimit: Prepared materials do not prove staff training, actual use, profile moderation or new customer reviews.
